summary: McGuire traveled to Israel in August 2025 on an AIPAC-branch (AIEF) trip, met Netanyahu, and urged him to 'get the job done' in Gaza, framing the visit as witnessing October 7 firsthand. He amplified Laura Loomer content portraying Hamas as focused on destroying Western Civilization and thanked her for 'exposing the truth.' Vote for Peace rated him Opposed in the general election.
